verdict.rationale: Cekura ingests live production calls, either by a post-call POST to its observability endpoint or by pulling from Retell every 30 seconds. It then automatically schedules metric evaluation (LLM-judge, Python and pre-defined metrics) on each call, with configurable sampling and live drift detection across every call. Note that Cekura's term "evaluators" refers to simulation test cases; its production-side scoring is done by metrics. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of production evaluation, and deeper docs on evaluation latency and alerting for production metric runs.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can run evaluators continuously on live production traffic, not just offline datasets

citations.quote: Your agent (or its provider's post-call webhook) POSTs here with the transcript, recording URL, and metadata; Cekura stores it as a `CallLog`, schedules metric evaluation, and surfaces it in Observability.
Cekura automatically pulls your call data from Retell's API every 30 seconds—no webhook configuration required.
you can configure a sampling rate (e.g., 30%) to evaluate metrics on a representative sample while maintaining statistical accuracy.
Live drift detection across every call.
